title: Storm Sorceress Lighthouse
description: A powerful sorceress with flowing white hair and a multicolored gown floats in the air beside a tall stone lighthouse on a rocky cliff during a violent storm. She holds a glowing magical staff as turquoise and purple energy swirls around her, with two wrecked wooden ships tossed in the turbulent, lightning-lit sea below.
prompt: A dramatic fantasy scene of a sorceress with long flowing white hair wearing a purple, pink and green gown floating midair beside a tall ancient stone lighthouse on a rocky outcrop. She holds an ornate glowing staff as swirling turquoise and purple magical energy and glowing particles surround her. Two broken wooden sailing ships are wrecked in the stormy turbulent ocean with large waves and lightning striking in a dark purple cloudy sky.
